extracted.intended_audience: B-WET grantees, education program staff, and local organizations drafting press releases about NOAA-funded or watershed education projects
extracted.subtask_description: A government-issued press-release template and guidance for announcing B-WET grants, project milestones, or other news about Meaningful Watershed Educational Experiences (MWEEs). It explains when to use a press release, how to format and distribute it, and what content to include.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended purpose/audience
rubrics_metrics.description: The sample press release is designed as an announcement to alert local media and other stakeholders that the area’s students, teachers, or schools will be or are participating in a B-WET project or other environmental program implementing MWEEs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains placeholders for specific project details, participating audiences, and a quote; remove placeholders prior to issuing. Template framed as a grant announcement but can be modified for milestones or other achievements.

rubrics_metrics.name: When to use a press release vs alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the press release template when you want to highlight something the news would be interested in covering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before drafting ask whether a press release is the best vehicle or whether a news blast, pitch call, or social media post would be more effective and efficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plain-text distribution / avoid attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid using email attachments, which increase the likelihood that your message will be caught in a spam filter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The plain-text press release can be copied and pasted into the body of an email, loaded into a web template, or shared as a stand-alone document or PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to share with local media
rubrics_metrics.description: To share the press release with local media, locate the email address for the news desk, news editor, or someone who writes about local education and copy and paste the press release into the body of an email.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively post the press release online, or use it as complementary background material along with other toolkit items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include key numbers/impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Tell the numbers, i.e. number of students/teachers impacted, number of NOAA scientists involved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make impact numbers prominent to quantify scope and reach of the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address who, what, when, where, why, and how
rubrics_metrics.description: Try to address who, what, when, where, why, and how.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the release answers these basic journalist questions clearly and concisely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify program/activity location
rubrics_metrics.description: Include where your program/activity takes place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give clear geographic or institutional location information so reporters and readers know the setting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact information and formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Include your contact information: telephone number and email is best.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use proper punctuation for telephone numbers: a dash after (not parentheses around) telephone area codes, and “ext.” before the extension number. Use one space after a period, not two.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of quotes and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Include quotes to share information and convey buy-in from others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider getting quotes from B-WET staff for national/regional context. Quotes should be no more than 2 sentences each, and the guidance recommends using at most 2 quotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attention-grabbing headline
rubrics_metrics.description: Create an attention grabbing headline! Use action words to highlight what you are trying to convey.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples provided (e.g., '[Local Area] Students to Study in Hands-on, Living Classroom with NOAA Scientists', 'NOAA B-WET-funded Project Helps [#] Students Experience Watershed'). Keep headlines active and newsy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Template structure and standard elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Use standard press-release elements: Date, Contact, For Immediate Release, headline, organizational lead sentence and body, program boilerplate, organization description, links, and an end marker.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Template includes placeholders for Date and Contact and instructs including 'For Immediate Release' and ending with '# # #'. Follow this structure so media know release status and how to follow up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project description content
rubrics_metrics.description: Insert a brief description about your project including who will be served and what you will do; include impact numbers, and how your project incorporates Meaningful Watershed Educational Experiences (MWEEs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The template gives a sample sentence describing duration, numbers of students and teachers, types of activities (outdoor and in-classroom), and intended outcomes (understanding and stewardship of local ecosystems). Use similar concrete details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include program boilerplate (NOAA B-WET)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a short description of the NOAA B-WET program as boilerplate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example text: 'The NOAA B-WET program is a competitive grants program that provides funding for K-12 STEM education focused on local watershed issues.' Provide a link to the program (sample URL given).

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization description and links
rubrics_metrics.description: Insert a brief description of your organization and include links to website/social media that directly refer to your project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If linking to a website, make sure URLs are preceded by the scheme, i.e., 'http://' or 'https://'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adaptability of template
rubrics_metrics.description: The template example is framed as an announcement about receiving a B-WET grant, but it could be modified to announce major project milestones or other key project achievements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customize placeholders and framing depending on whether announcing funding, milestones, events, or outcomes; ensure content remains newsworthy.
